result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same code as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. The `cli` module compiles. I didn't run any tests, and I didn't run either command or `-help` to check the output.

- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: the `analyzeLandscape` name goes to the same `updateLandscape(...)` method. That method now takes the command name and description, so `-help` prints the usage of whichever name the user typed.
- **`Commands.java`**: I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. `analyzeLandscape` is now listed in the no-argument usage overview.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Commands" section covering `init`, `generateReports`, `analyzeLandscape`, `updateLandscape` and `updateConfig`.
- **`CLAUDE.md`**: I left its command list alone, so it doesn't mention `analyzeLandscape` yet.
